metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, February 26, 1899, page 11.

facts.fact: Allen shot and fatally wounded Tim Confoy, a stage hand at Havlin's Theater, in his saloon after Confoy appeared to reach for a revolver, firing five shots from two revolvers
Allen said before leaving the saloon that he fired only after seeing Confoy try to draw his weapon
facts.quote: Then, you bet your life, I let the bloody fool have it, and have it right.

facts.fact: Allen surrendered his revolvers to Officer Clifford and was held at the Chestnut street station, then moved to the Four Courts holdover by order of Chief Pickel
Allen's saloon at 619 Market street was described as one of the toughest resorts in the city, which he handled by brute force as an old prizefighter

notes: Fifty or more patrons were also arrested; skipped as minor.
